name: protolint-previewable-transactional-auto-8a10
instr:
protolint cannot preview automatic-disable changes as structured plans before modifying source. Add matching CLI and library preview and apply workflows, preserving placement results, lint reporting, and error identities.

Placement strategies must produce repeatable, non-consuming plans in Disable call order. Each edit records its path, original byte range, replacement bytes, rule, and placement. Noop succeeds with an empty plan without reading its filename. Next and ThisThenNext keep their placement semantics.

Visitor plans include edits from exactly the callbacks producing failures, in failure discovery order. Mixed declaration failures may use different placements, but edits stay in visitor order until transaction normalization. Finalization or parse failure exposes no committable plan.

Transactions validate source snapshots and edit ranges before writing, rejecting overlaps and stale inputs. Apply only after every selected file and rule succeeds, atomically committing position-sorted rendering edits and returning exactly the plan written. Any stale snapshot, later-file failure, or other internal failure returns ErrInternalFailure, reports no commit, and restores every original byte.

Preview completes lint planning without modifying inputs and normalizes paths and original positions for deterministic JSON. CLI JSON and library preview return the same normalized plan. Multi-file Noop preview performs no filesystem-dependent placement work and emits one valid empty aggre
